note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after E3 renamed TestRFC4301TunnelModeInboundSelectorsAreEnforcedByTheRequirePolicy to TestRFC4301TunnelModeInboundSelectorsAreEnforcedByTheStateSelector in internal/component/ike/engine/rfc4301_sad_selector_linux_test.go. RFC 4301 Section 4.4.2: "For each of the selectors defined in Section 4.4.1.1, the entry for an inbound SA in the SAD MUST be initially populated with the value or values negotiated at the time the SA was created." The rename aligns the function name with its existing assertions (XfrmInStateMismatch +1, XfrmInNoPols and XfrmInPolBlock unchanged), and the body is unchanged. Every tagged fixture still negotiates a single selector pair (and TestRFC4301InboundSADEntryCarriesTheNegotiatedSelectors runs over mockDP, asserting only dp.policies[0] in tunnel mode), so multi-pair negotiated values and full Section 4.4.1.1 selector coverage remain unproven. Verdict stays weak.
